name: medo-design-system
description: med.o Design System – tokens, CSS, Tailwind theme, React components and Storybook.

scripts.storybook: npm run build:tokens && npm run dev -w @med-o/storybook
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build:tokens && npm run build -w @med-o/storybook
scripts.test: npm run build:tokens && npm run test -w @med-o/storybook
scripts.test:webkit: npm run build:tokens && npm run test:webkit -w @med-o/storybook
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build:tokens && npm run test:firefox -w @med-o/storybook
scripts.test:visual: npm run build:tokens && npm run test:visual -w @med-o/storybook
scripts.lint: npm run build:tokens && stylelint "packages/ui/src/**/*.css" "apps/storybook/.storybook/*.css" && node scripts/lint-tokens.mjs
